negative_findings.description: The intuitive press-centre paths https://raiffeisen.ua/about/press-center and https://about.pumb.ua/press-center both returned HTTP 404. The real paths are /about/press and /presscenter respectively.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two 404s; correct paths subsequently found via domain-scoped local-language search. Recorded as a path-discovery lesson, NOT as dead sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ukrainian bank sites do not follow the English 'press-center' convention consistently; a collector built on guessed paths will silently collect nothing. Always resolve newsroom paths from sitemap.xml or search before configuring a crawler.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on the PUMB press centre or the OTP Bank news index during inspection of those pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: PUMB offers month/year archive filters and OTP offers numeric pagination plus an email subscription, but neither surfaced a machine-readable feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be HTML-crawl based rather than feed based, which raises cost and fragility. Both sites do use enumerable IDs (PUMB /item/{id}-, OTP /about/news/{id}/), so ID-walking is a viable substitute for a feed and gives free gap detection.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated press centre or news path was located for àбанк / А-Банк on a-bank.com.ua despite Ukrainian-language searching with all three of its naming variants (А-Банк, Абанк, àбанк).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only third-party feeds (minfin, finance.ua, nv.ua, mind.ua, banker.ua) carrying A-Bank news. The bank's own newsroom either does not exist, is not indexed, or sits on an unguessed path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the seven named cell actors has no confirmed first-party record. Leadership and organisational news for A-Bank must be sourced through aggregators, which weakens provenance and delays detection. Needs a manual sitemap.xml reconnaissance pass.

negative_findings.description: The Sense Bank corporate domain (sensebank.com.ua) and the Ukrainian-language paths for Credit Agricole (/o-banke/pres-centr/novini, /o-banke/pravlinnya, derived by removing the /en/ prefix from confirmed English URLs) were inferred, not fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with reduced confidence scores and flagged for the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sense Bank is currently the highest-volatility actor in the cell (Aug 2026 suspensions of both board and supervisory board heads). Building on an unverified domain would silently drop the most active source. Verify before wiring into collection.

negative_findings.description: A legacy Raiffeisen path (https://raiffeisen.ua/ru/press/news/?id=62205) surfaced in search results with the title 'Just a moment...', indicating a Cloudflare-style JS challenge.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis only: bot-defended-but-live. The current-generation paths (/news, /en/news) did not show the same signature in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector for raiffeisen.ua should use a browser-capable fetcher with a realistic user agent rather than a bare HTTP client, and should not mark the domain dead on a challenge response.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian spelling variants materially change search recall: 'Райффайзен' (double ф) vs 'Райфайзен' (single ф) return different Work.ua result sets, and the bank legally dropped 'Аваль' from its name on 17 June, so 'Райффайзен Банк Аваль' now retrieves mostly pre-rename material. Similarly A-Bank has three live renderings (А-Банк / Абанк / àбанк, rebranded 16 Sep 2024) and Sense Bank's pre-2022 identity is Альфа-Банк Україна.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documented as a glossary/alias requirement rather than a source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any monitoring query set that fixes on one spelling will miss a large fraction of coverage, and time-series continuity across the rename events will break unless aliases are mapped to a single canonical entity.

negative_findings.description: The Ukrainian phrase 'призначення голови правління' is heavily dominated by state-sector results — Cabinet of Ministers decrees, state enterprises and NBU internal appointments crowd out commercial bank hits unless the query is bank-name-scoped or domain-scoped.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed on the first seed query, where the top result was a Cabinet of Ministers appointment decree for an unrelated state leasing company.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Generic appointment-term monitoring will produce a low signal-to-noise ratio for this cell. Queries must be anchored on the bank name or restricted to the bank's own domain / a specialist aggregator such as finclub.net.

coverage_gaps.description: No first-party newsroom confirmed for àбанк / А-Банк, and Sense Bank's newsroom path is unconfirmed. Two of the cell's actors therefore lack a verified direct source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a manual reconnaissance pass: fetch a-bank.com.ua/sitemap.xml and sensebank.com.ua/sitemap.xml, and try /news, /novyny, /pro-bank, /about/news, /press. If genuinely absent, formally designate the aggregator layer as the primary channel for those actors and lower expected detection latency accordingly.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass did not cover LinkedIn company pages, Facebook pages or Telegram channels for the cell's banks. For Ukrainian banks — and especially for monobank, whose founders communicate primarily via Telegram — social channels frequently break appointment and reorganisation news before the corporate site, and executives announce their own moves on LinkedIn before any employer release.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated social-channel discovery pass covering LinkedIn company pages and executive profiles, official Telegram channels, and Facebook pages for all seven actors. Assess ToS and access constraints for each platform separately, since LinkedIn scraping in particular is contractually restricted.

coverage_gaps.description: Only one structured organisational-structure disclosure was located (the OTP Bank shareholder-stakeholder PDF, dated 1 July 2026). UA transparency rules appear to impose a comparable obligation sector-wide, so equivalent artefacts almost certainly exist for PUMB, Raiffeisen, Credit Agricole, ProCredit and Universal Bank but were not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each remaining actor, locate the 'Розкриття інформації' / 'Інформація для акціонерів та стейкхолдерів' / 'Організаційна структура' page and its dated PDF, then set up version-hashing and org-tree diffing. This is the highest-yield unexploited vein for the 'organization changes' topic.

coverage_gaps.description: Group-level investor-relations channels of the foreign parents were not scouted: RBI (Raiffeisen Bank International, Vienna), OTP Group (Budapest), Crédit Agricole SA (Paris), ProCredit Holding AG (Frankfurt). Parents often announce or disclose subsidiary CEO changes and country-level restructuring in IR releases and annual reports before or instead of the local subsidiary.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the four parent IR/newsroom feeds as a supplementary tier, filtered for Ukraine mentions. Particularly important for RBI, whose Ukrainian and Russian operations are under continuous international scrutiny.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language (ru) variants of these bank sites still exist (e.g. raiffeisen.ua/ru/press/news) and hold historical archives, but ru is outside the declared run languages (uk, en). Older leadership-move records may only be retrievable in ru.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide explicitly whether historical backfill before ~2022 requires ru-path crawling; if yes, extend the language scope for archival collection only.

coverage_gaps.description: No web-archive strategy was established. Bank newsrooms prune old items and board roster pages are overwritten in place, so departures are erased rather than recorded. Confidence in historical leadership timelines therefore degrades sharply going backwards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Back every direct source in this cell with Wayback Machine snapshot retrieval (and submit fresh snapshots on each crawl), especially for the board roster pages whose entire evidentiary value comes from diffing across time.

brief: Ukraine's private and foreign-owned banks are well covered by their own first-party newsrooms, but on inconsistent URL conventions and with no RSS: OTP Bank is the strongest (explicit top-management appointment releases, a ~283-page dated archive, and a dated organisational-structure PDF), followed by PUMB, Raiffeisen, Credit Agricole, ProCredit and Universal Bank/monobank; A-Bank and Sense Bank currently lack a confirmed first-party channel. Because these banks announce arrivals far more readily than departures, the first-party layer must be paired with three corroboration layers: board-roster and org-chart page diffs, the NBU bank-managers register plus ЄДР registry change events, and the specialist aggregator finclub.net, whose per-banker dossiers and board-change feed are the best entity-resolution backbone available for this cell. Hiring signal is strong and cheap — Raiffeisen exposes a clean Workable ATS feed, PUMB runs career.pumb.ua, and Work.ua/Robota.ua/DOU cover the rest. The main risks are alias fragmentation (Райффайзен vs Райфайзен, the 2024 'Аваль' drop, А-Банк/Абанк/àбанк, Альфа-Банк→Sense Bank) and the state-sector noise that swamps generic Ukrainian appointment terminology, both of which require bank-name-anchored or domain-scoped querying.
